description: Ship module in REEF3D::FNPF: 1 m box barge in regular head waves, all six DOFs free, hybrid MMG (mmg_fluid 2: FNPF ideal-fluid loads + MMG hull derivatives without the Munk moment), approach phase from rest (ramp 1 s, free at 1.5 s), propeller with inflow sampled from the FNPF velocity, MMG rudder to 35 deg, 2 MPI ranks.
covers: FNPF psi_0 = chi (body-following time derivative, exact rigid-body Neumann data)
ship mmg_fluid 2 (hybrid, Munk moment out of N'v)
